test_title: PYST 09: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Knuckle down

options.text: To crush someone to the extent that they cannot get up
To start working or studying hard
To make others do their share of hard work using power

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"knuckle down"** means to start working or studying hard. (कड़ी मेहनत करना शुरू करना)

 
 
• **Example:** With the exams approaching, it's time to knuckle down and start studying seriously.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**
